conditions: Reference only for surface beauty floor, celestial scale, cloud softness, Aegir band detail, and moon readability. Product-face use requires owner approval, project-owned derivative textures, declared channels, import manifest, and visual proof.

risk_if_misused: Weakens the signature surface/celestial route, creates derivative material identity, and risks muddy placeholder-looking product-face art.
